fact: The Annuaire statistique 2022 (14th edition, December 2023) publishes 2017-2022 tables drawn from administrative sources: school returns (MEMP annuaires statistiques, MESTFP annuaires statistiques, SIPAGeS), health facility reports (MS/DPAF annuaires des statistiques sanitaires 2013-2022), public service records (DPAF/MTFP 2022, MSFTP), road transport records (MIT/CNSR), utility records (SBEE, SONEB, ANAEP-MR) and METEO-BENIN, alongside INStaD surveys and price data.
title: Annuaire statistique 2022
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie (INStaD)
